file_id: Marann Suresh Kumar, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 24 December, 2020

sentences.text: Marann Suresh Kumar, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 24

Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Honourable Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.6055 of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.179 of 2020 on the file of learned Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nandyal, Kurnool District, arising out of crime No.337 of 2019 of Nandyal III Town Police Station, Kurnool District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188 and 273 I.P.C. and Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nandyal, Kurnool District
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Nandyal III Town Police Station, Kurnool District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the common order, dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.
3.

In view of the submission of learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State, this Criminal Petition also stands allowed in terms of the aforesaid order.
As a sequel, all the pending miscellaneous applications shall stand closed.
Registry is directed to attach a copy of the common order, dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY, J 24th December,
